body.x: Reziena (CEO Shin Seung-woo) participated in CES 2024, the world’s largest IT and electronics exhibition held in Las Vegas, USA, from January 9th to 12th, from Tuesday to Friday.

Reziena is a startup in the beauty and medical convergence field, focusing on enhancing the quality of its ‘At Home’ care services. The ‘At Home’ care service platform simplifies procedures and equipment proven for safety and effectiveness in plastic surgery and dermatology, commercialized for general consumers.

Expanding research and development capabilities in this field, Reziena garnered industry attention by unveiling the world’s first high-intensity focused ultrasound (HIFU) device that does not require cartridge replacement.

The company successfully developed a smart mask product by applying eco-friendly bio-cell iontophoresis technology to mask sheets. This innovation was presented at CES 2023 last January, earning Reziena the honor of receiving the CES Innovation Award.

Reziena is progressing with the semiconductor-based materialization and modularization of ultrasound components, a core technology in the Medical Beauty field. Reziena showcased these research achievements along with existing product lines at CES 2024, showcasing the company’s technological competitiveness to global audiences once more.

body.cap: Reziena’s semiconductor ultrasound components unveiled at CES 2024 | Photo by AVING News

body.x: Reziena’s representative stated, “Our company possesses advanced capabilities and excellent potential in medical beauty technology, showcasing remarkable achievements and research and development results in this field. It’s particularly satisfying to present the technical principles and effects in a tangible way to visitors worldwide at this CES. It was an excellent opportunity for startups like us.”

“We’re participating in CES through Eureka Park for the second time this year. Last year, during the exhibition, we had meaningful encounters with major players in the global beauty industry, such as L’Oréal and Estée Lauder. We successfully engaged in joint research with some companies, achieving substantial results. We anticipate new opportunities this year as we meet potential customers and partners from the United States, Netherlands, Philippines, Turkey, and more,” said the company representative.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition organized by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), is held in Las Vegas every January, providing a comprehensive view of global innovative technology trends. AVING News, covering CES for 18 consecutive years, has been selecting the best innovative products, companies, and technologies and conducting ‘BEST OF CES’ and ‘BEST OF MADE IN KOREA’ selections. Additionally, through ‘AVING LIVE,’ they provide live coverage of CES issues.

The CES 2024 Seoul Pavilion is being operated on the most historical scale since Seoul’s first participation in CES in 2020, with the largest exhibition area, number of participating companies, and supporter numbers. The Seoul Pavilion, which has collaborated with 13 institutions, is essential in Seoul’s endeavors to establish itself as a startup hub. Among the participating companies in the Seoul Pavilion, 17 received innovation awards, proving their capabilities. Participating institutions include SBA, Seoul Bio Hub, Seoul Campus Town, Yangjae Innovation Hub, Gwanak-gu, Yonsei University, Korea University, Chung-Ang University, Sogang University, Kookmin University, Hanyang University, and Kyunghee University, totaling 13. Seoul City and institutions and supporters participating in industry-academic cooperation are matched 1:1 with companies, with a maximum of 85 supporters participating.
